task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice’s contact info and use it to check her availability starting on 2025-06-01, then create a medium-priority reminder for a doctor appointment on 2025-06-01 at 3:00 PM with the note “Check-up at 3pm.” After that, send Alice an app alert saying the reminder was created successfully, and then create a document titled “Doctor Appointment” with that same message, tagged finance and travel, and send the alert through the app as well.
